name: mood
author: 0xBreadguy
description: Music beneath your work. One bar item that shows the mood and whether it's playing, and is also the control. It streams openly licensed tracks one at a time, on demand, and starts nothing by itself.

barWidget.description: Click plays or pauses. Scroll down skips, scroll up goes back, scroll sideways (or hold right-click and scroll) changes the mood. Right-click opens the moods.

schema.label: Highlight color
schema.description: "theme" follows the Omarchy theme's accent. Or a color such as #7aa2f7.

schema.label: Animation
schema.description: One of the variants the chosen surface offers. Empty means the surface's first.

schema.label: Scroll that changes the mood
schema.description: sideways: scroll sideways (or hold right-click and scroll) changes the mood, up and down skip and go back. vertical: the other way round.

schema.label: Surface
schema.description: Which look draws the bar item and the popup. See plugin/surfaces/index.json.

schema.label: Answer the media keys
schema.description: Appear to the desktop as a media player titled with the mood, so play/pause, next and previous keys work. Applies the next time the player starts.

schema.label: Sound output
schema.description: For working on the plugin: "null" plays in real time into nothing. Applies the next time the player starts.
